OhGeesy, born Alejandro Coranza, is a Los Angeles rapper and one of the founding members of the iconic West Coast rap group Shoreline Mafia. Raised in Hollywood, California, OhGeesy helped bring a new wave of West Coast hip-hop to the mainstream with hits like “Musty,” “Nun Major,” and “Bands.” Known for his laid-back flow, catchy hooks, and signature California sound, he has become one of the most recognizable figures in LA’s rap scene.

Following Shoreline Mafia’s rise to fame, OhGeesy launched a successful solo career, releasing projects like GEEZYWORLD and collaborating with major artists including DaBaby, YG, and A Boogie Wit da Hoodie.

Travis Scott, born Jacques Bermon Webster II, is a Grammy-nominated rapper, singer, songwriter, and producer from Houston, Texas. He is one of the biggest names in modern hip-hop, known for his psychedelic trap sound, high-energy performances, and chart-topping hits like “SICKO MODE,” “goosebumps,” and “FE!N.”

Travis rose to superstardom through albums like Rodeo, Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight, ASTROWORLD, and UTOPIA. Beyond music, he has built a massive cultural influence through his Cactus Jack brand and collaborations with Nike and Jordan Brand.

OhGeesy has also continued releasing music, including his 2025 album Paid N Full, while reconnecting musically with Shoreline Mafia. 

Travis Scott’s influence extends beyond his own albums through his Cactus Jack label and collaborations with other artists.
